suspense_fix_details.problem: Shared Suspense boundary between lazy-loaded tabs caused React insertBefore errors during rapid tab switching
suspense_fix_details.solution: Each tab now has its own <Suspense> wrapper (App.jsx lines 91-171). LazyFallback moved outside render as stable element (lines 32-37)
suspense_fix_details.verification: Rapid tab switching (10+ switches) with no console errors
